summary.text: Ryan Spiegel is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 17 who has served since June 15, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Spiegel earned a bachelor's degree in journalism from the University of Maryland in 2000 and a J.D. from Stanford University in 2003.
He is a partner at the law firm Thompson Hine LLP.
Spiegel served on the Gaithersburg, Maryland, City Council from 2007 to 2023.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed Spiegel to the House of Delegates on June 15, 2023, to replace Kumar Barve.
